title: Amendments
key_points: Amendments are changes to the Ripple protocol that have been approved by the decentralized network.
Amendments add new features or capabilities to the XRPL protocol.
They can also fix bugs, improve performance, and update other aspects of the protocol.
The amendment process allows for ongoing evolution and improvement of the XRPL protocol.
limitations: The documentation does not provide specific details on how often amendments are made or what types of changes they typically entail.
It focuses more on the process of amending rather than the actual content of amendments themselves.
The relevance to practical implementation and usage of XRPL may be limited, being primarily a reference for developers.
asserts: Amendments allow approved changes to be made to the Ripple protocol in order to add new features or improve existing capabilities.
scope: The scope of this source is the process by which approved changes (amendments) are added to the Ripple protocol to evolve and enhance its features and capabilities.
